cues: Air has no stiffness against sideways shearing, so it cannot pass on a transverse vibration.
The air molecules can only push on their neighbours along the direction of travel, making compressions and rarefactions.
text: B, longitudinal. Air has no stiffness against sideways shearing, so it cannot pass on a transverse vibration. The air molecules can only push on their neighbours along the direction of travel, making compressions and rarefactions.
